description: Scrolling carousel with autoplay, looping, indicators, and view transitions

attributes.name: autoplay
attributes.description: Auto-advance slides and render a pause/play rotation control (ignored under reduced motion)

attributes.name: loop
attributes.description: Loop back to start after last slide

attributes.name: item-width
attributes.description: Slide width: "full" (default), "auto" (content width), or a CSS length such as "18rem"

structure.description: Each direct child becomes a slide

events.name: carousel-wc:change
events.description: Fired once per slide change (scroll settling is debounced)

events.name: carousel-wc:play
events.description: Fired when the autoplay timer starts or resumes (including after a hover/focus suspension ends)

events.name: carousel-wc:pause
events.description: Fired when the autoplay timer stops: explicit pause, or a hover/focus/touch suspension

events.name: carousel-wc:slides-changed
events.description: Fired after the slides property rebuilds the carousel

methods.name: next()
methods.description: Go to the next slide (wraps with loop)

methods.name: prev()
methods.description: Go to the previous slide (wraps with loop)

methods.name: goTo(index, smooth = true)
methods.description: Jump to a slide; out-of-range indexes are ignored

methods.name: play()
methods.description: Start or resume rotation; overrides a hover/focus suspension. No-op under reduced motion

methods.name: pause()
methods.description: Stop rotation until play() or the rotation control resumes it

methods.name: reset()
methods.description: Return to the start slide and clear persistence

properties.name: playing
properties.description: Whether the autoplay timer is running right now (read-only; false while suspended by hover/focus)

properties.name: slides
properties.description: Get the slides as data, or assign records to rebuild the carousel
